description: Finds a product on 1688 from its photo: derniere_photo or urls_photos (https images, 5 max). Use when they want to buy a product seen in an image from the web. One photo = one search. `correspondance` first, no other image. same_product checks that a result is the same product.

derniere_photo.description: true: the last photo they sent to Rabbit (the send_a_photo link, the app or the Chrome extension), within the last two hours.

url_photo.description: The https address of the product photo.

urls_photos.description: Up to 5 https addresses of images of the product (the ones you show them or find on the web). One search per photo, returned photo by photo.

name: search_by_photo
title: Search 1688 by photo
